results.title: Sivakasi’s fireworks industry: sparkling opportunities up ahead
results.content: Have you ever wondered where the fireworks that light up your skies on Deepavali day come from? Let’s travel to Sivakasi, India’s fireworks capital, and discover the people, passion and industry behind the festival’s dazzling celebrations.

Prime Minister felicitates India’s Asian Para Games 2026 contingent
results.content: Visakhapatnam-based Indian para-badminton coach M.V. Murali Krishna, whose team won 16 medals (three gold, five silver, and eight bronze), calls for grassroots-level growth to nurture India’s para-athlete talent

results.title: Three major fires hit Delhi’s commercial hubs ahead of Deepavali; fire service on high alert
results.content: Blazes in Karol Bagh, Gandhi Nagar and Saket highlight firefighting challenges in congested markets; 325 fire vehicles in operation and 3,000 personnel on duty over the festival weekend, with no leave or weekly offs permitted
